scope: Public shipped frontend source and synthetic native appearance regressions; no private account settings or browser localStorage read.

observed.accountStore: Authenticated user_prefs row keyed by user_id; select prefs, at most one row. Official module65254 merges per-key timestamps across device local cache and account row.
observed.colourSource: Module 33873 contains 20 preset pairs. Custom a/b/c values use six-digit hex colours; intensity is clamped to 0.15–1, defaulting to 0.75.
observed.background: The official app CSS layers elliptical radial and linear colour gradients behind translucent panels. This observed contract contains no image-wallpaper field.
observed.serverOverride: Module 31691 reads server.theme.{accent,tint}. It honours the server_theme rollout and the personal serverThemes opt-out. A personal tint takes background priority while the server accent can remain active.

nativeImplementation.accountGuard: Late replies and stale refresh calls cannot apply after an account change. Failed reads retain the current known appearance.
nativeImplementation.scopeGuard: Nested server, DM and settings scopes restore their mounted parent when they disappear. Updating a hidden parent does not replace the foreground scope. Foreign-account scopes are ignored.
nativeImplementation.localThemeOverride: An explicit dark/light/system choice belongs to its account and can be cleared with Website-Design neu laden.

iOS17Swift6Typecheck.scope: Exact new core, palette and background SwiftUI code, with minimal API/UI stubs; this is not a whole-app build.

verification.visualParity: Source-informed native gradient; pixel equality has not been established.

parentVerification.qualification: Combined synthetic Xcode unit run; later fixes affect UI only. See native-0.2.4-validation.json for final builds and interaction evidence.
